title: Construct Project Configuration
description: Schema for construct.config.json, the source of truth for project-level Construct settings. Shared and committed to the repo.

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema for this file.

alias.description: The display name for this Construct project instance.

scope.description: The active organizational scope ID. Determines which specialists and capabilities are available.

mode.description: The operational mode of the Construct instance.

mcpBroker.description: Controls the engagement of the MCP (Model Context Protocol) broker.

projectName.description: The unique name of the project. Used for multi-project telemetry and storage.

tenantId.description: The tenant ID for enterprise deployments.

workerBackend.description: The execution environment for orchestrated workers.

store.description: The storage engine for orchestration state and task graphs.

chainOfThought.description: Disclosure of a provider-executed specialist's reasoning during orchestration. 'hidden': reasoning is not requested or shown. 'surface': reasoning is requested and attached to each task so the CLI, MCP, and dashboard display it. 'telemetry_only': reasoning is requested and written to the run trace but never displayed.

outcomeRouting.description: Whether recruitment breaks ties between equally-specialized candidates using each role's recent outcome success rate (a bounded ±0.05 nudge that can never override the primary specialization signal). 'off' restores plain alphabetical tie-breaking.

enabled.description: Whether to record session traces and token usage.

ingest.description: Strategy for ingesting and indexing project documents.

strategy.description: The primary mechanism for extracting text from files.

fallback.description: The secondary mechanism if the primary strategy fails.

orchestration.description: Determines if intake processing is a simple prompt or an orchestrated workflow.

providers.description: Provider-specific settings (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub). Values starting with '$' are interpolated from environment variables.

sources.description: Typed integration source targets for embed auto-discovery and provider_fetch.

writes.description: Governed external-write policy (lib/writes/). Fail-safe default is 'approval' for any write not listed here. Not enforced by this schema alone — lib/writes/write-policy.mjs validateWritePolicyConfig() is the authoritative check, run by writeProjectConfig().

policy.description: Per governed write kind ("<provider>.<writeKind>", e.g. "jira.comment"), which disposition the write-intent-drain daemon job applies to a pending approval before a human ever sees it: 'auto' grants it immediately, 'deny' rejects it immediately, 'approval' (the default for anything unlisted) leaves it queued for a human.

directives.description: Standing instructions attached to a provider (e.g. "watch Jira, summarize what the team is working on"). lib/directives/directive-config.mjs validateDirectives() is the authoritative check, run by writeProjectConfig(); a directive never executes on its own — lib/embed/daemon.mjs's write-intent-drain-adjacent "directive-runner" job only records that one is due.

intakePolicy.description: Filesystem inbox watcher policy. The canonical drop zone is inbox/ at the project root (always watched, ADR-0045 §C); maxDepth and additionalDirs tune the scan.

maxDepth.description: Subdirectory scan depth per watched directory

additionalDirs.description: Extra directories to watch beyond inbox/ (opt-in)

artifactWorkflow.description: Project overrides for manifest-backed artifact workflows. Per-invocation overrides take precedence over these values, which take precedence over Construct defaults.

models.description: Model catalog visibility and live polling preferences.

include.description: Allowlist used when mode is explicit.

exclude.description: Model ids hidden from pickers (active pin still shown with warning).

providers.description: Per provider-family toggles; false hides the family from pickers.

liveOpenRouter.description: Merge cached live OpenRouter free models into the catalog.

maxLiveFree.description: Maximum live free models merged from cache.

totalCxMaxMb.description: Maximum disk usage for the .cx/ directory (MB).
